name: Superteam India Community Call [2026]
description:
Superteam is a network of operators, devs & grantees working on promising Solana projects.

Simply put, it is a gated Slack Workspace for those who satisfy the membership criteria. There’s no treasury, take-rate/commissions, or token sale. From its inception, Superteam has chosen to be a collective of sovereigns over a sovereign collective. Any revenue generated is captured by the individual members or teams that self-organize and win a bounty, and secure a grant or venture funding for their ideas.

The community is the product. And members have exclusive access to the product.

Our community call is the one time every week when Superteam India members get together to,

• celebrate wins
• share project updates & demos
• find teammates or ask for help
• hear from the occasional guest speakers
• get updates, alpha & news you can use about Superteam & the wider Solana ecosystem

Every Thursday, 6pm. Join us!

## VIEW THE FULL EVENT SCHEDULE HERE (https://techweekend.org/)

What is Tech Weekend? A 48-hour fundraising sprint by Founders Village where pre-seed to Series A founders meet dozens of investors in back-to-back meetings.

Who should attend?

Pre-seed to Series B Tech Startups.

Looking at the investors joining us in September, here's where their attention seems to be for this cohort

▪️ Physical AI — robotics, sensors, industrial automation, and the machines reshaping manufacturing, construction, and mobility.

▪️ Semiconductors and AI chips — the silicon underneath all of it.

▪️ Deep tech, defense, space tech and dual-use, alongside cybersecurity and enterprise infrastructure.

▪️ Fintech and financial services — banking technology, financial infrastructure, and the security that protects it.

▪️ Health tech and biotech — health and wellness, digital health care solutions, pharma production, oncology, and medical devices.

▪️ Climate and energy — adaptation and resilience, clean energy, electrification, batteries, and transportation.

▪️ AI, across the whole stack — infrastructure, enterprise, application layer, AI-ready data, and the work of making it safe and interpretable.

▪️ And a good number of the investors are sector agnostic, backing exceptional founders building in any industry.

If you're building in any of these areas and looking for capital to scale, consider applying for Tech Weekend Cohort September 2026

Across two days, Founders connect with investors through:

▪️ VC Office Hours: 20–30-minute one-on-one meetings with top investors who are investing in your space. At least 8 meetings are assigned to each founder with a cohort pass.

▪️ Pitch Competition: Present to a panel of active VCs. Get real-time feedback and offers to chat more offline.

▪️ VC Panels & Fireside Chats: Gain insights from investors who've deployed millions. Hear what they're looking for and how to stand out.

▪️ Networking Mixer: All-day networking mixers with founders, investors and engineers gathered from across the United States and abroad.

name: Blockchain Week - UNGA Edition 2026 | 10 Days (Sept 10–19)
description:
## The Most Important Event of the Year

Where Global Leaders, Policymakers and Visionaries Shape the Future
September 10 to 19, 2026 · Times Square, New York City

About the Event

In an increasingly unpredictable world, one gathering rises above the noise as the single most strategic opportunity of 2026: Blockchain Week - UNGA Edition.

The centerpiece of the 10-day week is an exclusive two-day conference on September 16 and 17, timed with the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA 81) and New York Fashion Week, staged in Midtown Manhattan with our marquee presence in Times Square.

This is not another blockchain conference. This is where senior policymakers, institutional investors, government officials, energy executives and the world's top builders converge for high-signal dialogue on real-world adoption, nation-state strategy, and the future of finance, AI, energy and the space economy.

The world's leaders will be in New York. The most important conversations in blockchain will happen here.

Speakers

Brock Pierce. President Vít Jedlička of Liberland. Michael Terpin. Hugh Dugan, former US diplomat. Alex Lightman. Nikita Sachdev. Dr. Levan Bodzashvili. Karla Ballard. Lou Kerner. Jimmy Nguyen. Rick Tumlinson.

Full confirmed lineup at blockchainweek.ai/speakers (https://blockchainweek.ai/speakers)

Featured Artist: KOVO

KOVO (Steven Koveleski) is a contemporary artist, creative director and cultural strategist working at the intersection of art, technology, community and impact. His work explores human connection, collective progress and the systems shaping our shared future. Through Kovo Art, he builds visual experiences and collaborations that bring people together and turn complex ideas into powerful, human-centered stories.

As Featured Artist for Blockchain Week 2026, KOVO brings that practice to New York, giving a week of conversation about technology, trust and governance a visual language anyone can walk up to and feel. His work appears across the week and is showcased at BitcoinPalooza on September 17.

Why This Is the Most Important Week of the Year

Unmatched access. Direct proximity to the global governance class during the one week they are all physically in New York.

High-signal programming. Focused, curated content at the true intersection of policy and innovation.

Elite audience. Institutional investors, government advisors, energy leaders and technologists already in Manhattan for UNGA.

Culture on the same stage as policy. Art, music and fashion programmed alongside the boardroom conversation, not as an afterthought to it.

Real impact. These are the conversations that influence policy outcomes and strategic national positioning.

Sep 16 · Conference Day 1, from 9am, Gallery MC, 549 W 52nd St, New York, NY 10019. Bitcoin, Policy and Institutional Infrastructure. Opening keynote on blockchain's role in global governance. Nation-state Bitcoin adoption. Regulatory outlook post-UNGA season. Institutional readiness, capital markets and compliance architecture. Blockchain and the energy system.

Sep 17 · Conference Day 2, from 9am, Gallery MC, 549 W 52nd St. AI, Energy, Space and Real-World Impact. Keynote on the convergence of AI and blockchain. AI agents and decentralized systems. Tokenization of real-world assets. The space economy. Climate and energy applications, and measurable progress against the SDGs.

Sep 17 · BitcoinPalooza, Sugar Mouse NYC, 47 3rd Ave, New York, NY 10003. Doors 7pm. The official after party, following Day 2. Live performances, a fashion show, select talks, and work from Featured Artist KOVO. Included for conference attendees.

Sep 18 · Washington Elite Investment Summit and Gala, from 4pm, Gallery MC, 549 W 52nd St. Returning for a 4th year as the flagship closing night. Black tie. Investors, family offices, institutional leaders and decision-makers. Included with VIP tickets only.

Sep 19 · Pause the World for Peace, 11am to 1pm, Times Square. The 24th annual live clean energy International Day of Peace Concert, in collaboration with Paul Sladkus.

12+ official events. 10 days. Midtown, the East Village and Times Square.

Who Attends

A curated audience across the week, including senior policymakers and government officials, institutional investors and family offices, energy executives and sustainability leaders, blockchain builders and protocol teams, AI and space economy pioneers, and fashion-tech and creative industry leaders.

Tickets

We are inside the final week before doors open, and VIP is capped.

General Admission, full week access. $399. Access to all public events, panels and runways. Bitcoin, AI, energy, space and fashion-tech content. Networking across the full week. Live calendar and side events. Digital pass and recordings.

VIP Pass, all-access plus Gala. $1,499. Everything in General Admission, plus the Washington Elite Investment Summit and Gala on September 18. Premium networking lounge. VIP swag bag and photo ops. Priority seating at all key events. Private after-parties and investor dinners.

Limited VIP tickets available.

Secure your ticket right here on this Luma page, or at blockchainweek.ai (https://blockchainweek.ai)

Blockchain Week 2026 (UNGA Edition) is an independent initiative and is not affiliated with the United Nations.

name: The Hitchhiker’s Guide to Silicon Valley Ft. Kim Kolt & Brian Mac Mahon
description:
## The Hitchhiker’s Guide to Silicon Valley: A Founder’s Playbook for Building the Future

Join us as we feature the delicious brains of investors Kim Kolt (GP, Bay Bridge Ventures) and Brian Mac Mahon (Director, Nathan Family Office) for an unfiltered, candid conversation on what it actually takes to navigate today's shifting landscape. Forget the polished PR narratives—this session exposes the hard realities of building, funding, and exiting tech companies in the current macro climate.

Key Discussion Topics

• New Vehicles for Liquidity: How public markets are evolving and why Private Equity is swallowing VC, forcing founders to build for PE roll-ups and distressed AI exits instead of public listings.
• Global Innovation Pitfalls: A direct look at regulation, capital efficiency, and why regions like the EU continue to struggle to foster high-growth tech ecosystems.
• Cutting Through the Noise: How seasoned investors spot the fine line between a true visionary and a charismatic BS'er in under five minutes.
• Investor Blindspots & Myths: The metrics and pitch deck elements founders obsess over that investors actually ignore when making real check-writing decisions.
• The Silicon Valley Love-Hate Paradox: Why top investors and founders still flock to the Bay Area despite its glaring flaws, expensive overhead, and high friction.

name: AI in the Wild: Silicon Valley Backyard BBQ
description:
Good conversations don't always happen in conference rooms. Sometimes the best ones happen around a backyard grill.

Join fellow Women Defining AI members for a relaxed afternoon of food, thoughtful conversation, and community as we gather in the heart of Silicon Valley for the next AI in the Wild experience.

We'll enjoy a casual backyard barbecue, share ideas over good food, and create space for the conversations we rarely have time for during conferences, Zoom calls, or busy workdays. Throughout the afternoon, we'll mix and mingle through a few lightly facilitated activities designed to help us connect, learn from one another, and explore what's next—for AI, our careers, and our lives.

Rather than a formal workshop or networking event, this gathering is about strengthening relationships, exchanging ideas, and creating space for authentic conversations in a welcoming, relaxed setting.

Along the way, we'll explore questions such as:

• What's one AI tool, workflow, or idea that's genuinely excited you recently?
• What challenge are you currently navigating that this community might help you think through?
• What are you most curious to learn next?
• Where do you see the greatest opportunities—or responsibilities—for women shaping the future of AI?
• How can we continue supporting one another as this community grows?

WE HOPE PARTICIPANTS LEAVE FEELING...

• Connected to an incredible community of women who are shaping the future of AI
• Inspired by what we'll learn about and build together next
• Energized by new ideas, perspectives, and conversations
• Connected to new friends, collaborators, and future thought partners
• Encouraged to stay engaged with the Women Defining AI community

FOOD

We'll provide the grill, along with hotdogs, veggie dogs, buns, and a few basics. We will also provide a few alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverage options.

Potluck contributions are appreciated but completely optional. You may consider bringing:

• Something you'd like to grill
• Or a favorite appetizer, side dish, dessert, or beverage to share

GETTING HERE

Street parking is available throughout the neighborhood with a few spots available in the driveway. Carpooling is great! We're ~8–10 minute walk from the Downtown San Mateo Caltrain Station.

WHAT TO BRING

• Comfortable clothing and shoes—we'll spend most of our time outdoors.
• A light jacket or sweater for the evening if you'd like.
• Your curiosity, favorite AI stories, and willingness to connect with others.

A QUICK NOTE: We have two small, friendly dogs—about the size of housecats—who may come by to say hello during the afternoon.

ABOUT WOMEN DEFINING AI: Women Defining AI is a community helping more women confidently learn, experiment with, and shape the future of artificial intelligence. Through hands-on workshops, open knowledge-sharing, leadership programs, bold initiatives, mentorship, and peer collaboration, members build practical AI skills while supporting one another’s ambitions. Together, the community is working to close the gender-tech gap and expand opportunities for women to found, invest in, purchase, and lead the technologies transforming our world.

ABOUT GEODE LIFEWORKS: Geode Lifeworks empowers leaders, organizations, and communities to navigate uncertainty with confidence, curiosity, and courage. From AI and emerging technologies to climate, market disruption, and organizational shifts, we design experiences that help people build the adaptive leadership skills, meaningful connections, and practical approaches needed to thrive through change.

AI in the Wild is Geode Lifeworks' signature event series, bringing conversations about AI beyond the boardroom and into our communities through thoughtful dialogue, movement, and shared experiences.

WE CAN'T WAIT TO WELCOME YOU FOR AN AFTERNOON OF GREAT FOOD, INSPIRING CONVERSATIONS, AND COMMUNITY.

name: AI x Crypto: Innovation, Efficiency and Staying Safe in a New Digital Economy
description:
## AI x Crypto: Innovation, Efficiency and Staying Safe in a New Digital Economy

Artificial intelligence is rapidly reshaping the crypto and blockchain landscape, moving beyond basic automation into smart research, dynamic risk management, and adaptive trading tools that can help users process information and navigate increasingly complex digital markets.

However, operating at the speed of AI presents a fresh set of challenges. Fast execution, complex automated tools, and shifting market environments mean users need to understand not just the opportunities, but how to navigate potential technical limits and emerging risks safely.

Join this educational discussion to explore the opportunities and challenges at the intersection of AI and crypto. We will look at how AI is transforming the sector, what users should be aware of, and the practical steps everyone can take to use emerging tools more safely and responsibly.

## Discussion Topics

• How AI is transforming crypto: The role of AI in blockchain products, user experiences, data analysis, customer support, security monitoring and operational efficiency.
• New products and opportunities: How AI-enabled tools are changing the way people interact with wallets, decentralised applications, market information and digital-asset platforms.
• Efficiency and automation: Where AI can help simplify complex processes, improve access to information and support better decision-making.
• Understanding Tool Capabilities & Limits: Knowing what AI can and cannot do
• Responsible Adoption & Oversight: Building the core financial knowledge and critical-thinking habits needed to guide AI tools safely, rather than relying on them blindly.

## Schedule:

• 6.30pm - Welcome, registration and check in
• 7.15pm - Fireside chat
• 7.45pm - Networking drinks and pizzas

Passionate about making Web3 accessible, Lucia frequently shares her expertise through industry conferences and webinars. Specialising in integrated field marketing, she designs high-impact experiences that accelerate demand, build robust pipelines, and deepen customer engagement across the Fintech landscape.

Zebec is a leader in global stablecoin payroll, processing $500M+ in volume across 280+ enterprise clients. Since 2021, we've built an ecosystem spanning payroll, payments, banking infrastructure, and multi-chain Mastercard-backed cards, enabling enterprises to pay employees globally in real time and give them instant access to their funds.

## About Bitget (https://www.bitget.com/en-GB)

Bitget is a leading global cryptocurrency exchange serving over 125 million users worldwide. In the UK market, the platform delivers an innovation-driven spot trading experience featuring access to over 200 digital assets. name: Bitcoin 203: Multi-Sig Transactions: Securing Your Bitcoin with Multiple Keys
description:
Looking for the ultimate in Bitcoin security? Locking your bitcoin with multiple keys is a simple, effective solution!

Bitcoin educator and Space member, Tim McTavish, will teach you how to easily create your own multi-sig solution using Sparrow Wallet. No third-party needed!

During this session, we will create a 2-of-3 multi-sig using three keys from participants. We will send ~$20 USD worth of bitcoin to this wallet. From there, we will randomly select a participant to receive this bitcoin. We will then execute a 2-of-3 signature, sending the bitcoin from our multi-sig to this lucky participant!

What you'll learn:
What is a multi-sig?
Why and when should I use multi-sig?
How do you best manage multi-sig keys?
What is a PSBT file and how/when might I use it?

What to bring (optional):
A "receive" address in case you are the lucky winner of $20 worth of bitcoin!
Your laptop with Sparrow Wallet installed
Your signing device

name: Canada-Africa Innovation Partnership Summit | Implementing the Next Phase of Economic, Innovation, and Diplomatic Partnerships.
description:
Moving Canada's Africa Strategy from policy to implementation.

Hosted By The Canada-Africa Strategic Innovation Partnership Alliance (CASIPA).

The Canada-Africa Innovation Partnership Summit brings together decision-makers responsible for turning these national priorities into measurable action.

This executive forum moves beyond policy discussion. Participants will identify partnership opportunities, institutional priorities, investment pathways, research collaboration, and implementation mechanisms that support Canada's long-term engagement with Africa.

The summit will contribute to practical recommendations for governments, universities, investors, founders, corporations, innovation organizations, and the African diaspora.

EVENT AGENDA:

The summit will identify practical actions that strengthen Canada-Africa partnerships through innovation, trade, research, investment, diplomacy, entrepreneurship, education, and institutional collaboration.

The discussion will support implementation priorities identified within Canada's Africa Strategy while creating opportunities for sustained collaboration between Canadian and African organizations.

EXECUTIVE DISCUSSION THEMES

Strengthening Canada-Africa Diplomatic Partnerships

Discussion will examine new models for institutional cooperation between governments, universities, business associations, and international organizations while strengthening people-to-people engagement and diaspora participation.

Trade, Investment and Economic Cooperation

Participants will identify opportunities for investment, commercial partnerships, supply chain diversification, implementation of the African Continental Free Trade Area, and greater private sector collaboration between Canada and African economies.

Innovation, Research and Commercialization

Discussion will focus on joint research initiatives, technology commercialization, startup collaboration, university partnerships, artificial intelligence, advanced manufacturing, critical minerals, clean technology, health innovation, and knowledge transfer.

Diaspora Leadership

Participants will examine practical approaches for engaging African diaspora communities as strategic partners in investment, innovation, entrepreneurship, education, trade, and diplomacy, consistent with Canada's commitment to strengthen diaspora engagement.

Youth, Skills and Future Workforce Development

The discussion will identify collaborative approaches supporting entrepreneurship, technical education, research exchange, workforce development, and youth employment across Canada and Africa.

IMPLEMENTATION PRIORITIES

Participants will work toward practical recommendations for:

• Canada-Africa Innovation Partnerships

• Bilateral Research Collaborations

• Institutional Memoranda of Understanding

• Investment Readiness Programs

• Startup Exchange Initiatives

• University Partnership Networks

• Trade and Investment Missions

• Public-Private Partnerships

• Talent Mobility Programs

• Diaspora Engagement Frameworks

• Policy Collaboration Mechanisms

• Long-term Canada-Africa Partnership Roadmaps

EXPECTED OUTCOMES

• Executive implementation recommendations

• Cross-sector partnership commitments

• New institutional collaborations

• Research and innovation initiatives

• Investment opportunities

• Government engagement priorities

• University collaboration framework

• Diaspora engagement recommendations

• Canada-Africa implementation roadmap

EVENT DETAILS

Canada-Africa Innovation Partnership Summit

Implementing the Next Phase of Economic, Innovation, and Diplomatic Partnerships

Thursday, August 19, 2026

3:00 PM to 6:00 PM EDT

Virtual Executive Conference

Hosted by

Canada-Africa Strategic Innovation Partnership Alliance

REGISTRATION CALL TO ACTION

Canada's renewed engagement with Africa requires coordinated action across government, industry, academia, investment, entrepreneurship, and civil society. This summit brings together leaders prepared to contribute practical ideas, establish institutional partnerships, and support long-term implementation of Canada's Africa Strategy. Join the discussion and help shape the next phase of Canada-Africa cooperation.

name: WoCS Austin X Cloudflare: The Forward Deployed Era + CS's Shift to Revenue
description:
## About Event

A new role is showing up on org charts across tech, and it's quietly taking the work that used to define the CSM seat.

The Forward Deployed Engineer is now hands-on with implementation and technical delivery in a way that used to sit with Customer Success. As that work moves off the CSM's plate, the CSM seat isn't disappearing, it's being redefined.

That is the real shift, and it is what this evening is about. When technical delivery is no longer how you prove your value, that value has to show up somewhere else, and more and more that somewhere is the number: the renewal, the expansion, the growth of the account. So the questions get practical fast. What do you hand off? What do you hold onto? And how do you build the language and instincts of someone who owns revenue, even if your title does not say so yet?

This time you'll hear from both sides of that handoff: a Forward Deployed Engineer who can tell you exactly what the role owns and why it exists, and a senior Cloudflare Customer Success leader whose team recently brought FDEs into the org, so she has lived what changes for CS when that work moves. The evening moves from fireside chat into small-group roundtable conversations, so every attendee leaves with a specific next step for wherever they sit in this shift.

As always, bites and beverages will be provided 🍽️

## Fireside Chat Speakers

## What We'll Dive Into

• What a Forward Deployed Engineer actually does, and how it differs from a Technical Account Manager or Sales Engineer
• What changes when technical delivery splits off from the CSM seat, and why this is happening industry-wide at the same time
• Who owns the technical build or deployment now, and what CSMs are starting to own instead
• Owning the number: what revenue ownership looks like for CSMs today, how CS value gets measured when it's less about hands-on technical work, and how the FDE partnership shows up in renewals and expansion
• The hardest part of the transition: proving your value and staying close to the customer when you're no longer hands-on with the technical work
• What to build toward over the next year to stay ahead of this shift rather than behind it

## What You'll Take Away

• Real talking points for the handoff conversations happening in your own org right now, straight from people who have lived this restructuring from both sides of it
• Small-group time to work through the one question that hits closest to home for you, alongside peers navigating the same shift
• A clearer read on what to build toward over the next year: the skills, habits, or relationships that put you ahead of this shift rather than behind it

## Who This Is For

• CSMs and Account Managers figuring out what's staying on their plate and what's moving off it
• CS leaders and Directors/VPs who already own, or are being asked to own, a revenue number
• Women working in Onboarding, Implementation, or Technical Account Management wondering what the creation of the FDE role means for them
• Anyone in post-sales who wants to learn more about the Forward Deployed Engineer function

This event is part of the Women of Customer Success community, built for women working in tech and post-sales. If that's you, we'd love to have you in the room.

## How to Access the Cloudflare Office

Enter Cloudflare along Comal St. and check-in at the front desk. Our event will be hosted on the first floor, to the right of security!

## About Women of Customer Success

WoCS is the leading community for the best and brightest women in post-sales roles and leadership. Our mission is to connect, educate, and empower women to thrive in their careers and lead the way forward. With over 10 chapters worldwide, we are cultivating the next generation of women shaping the future of customer experience.

✨ Join the online community and register for our newsletter (https://womenofcustomersuccess.com/join)

✨ Follow us on LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/women-of-customer-success/)

name: Ethereum Institutional Summit 2026
description:
## About

A one-day, invitation-only summit in Tokyo for institutional decision-makers and the founders and researchers shaping the institutional layer of Ethereum.

The summit brings together global institutional investors, Japanese financial institutions, and project leaders for the first time in Japan at this scale.

The summit takes up the moment Ethereum evolves beyond a digital asset into the financial infrastructure of enterprises.

Stablecoin payments connecting corporate treasuries, tokenized real-world assets entering institutional portfolios, onchain treasury operations restructuring accounting and audit, and institutional-grade DeFi protocols — these are no longer thought experiments. They are working systems being built, deployed, and evaluated right now.

Held in English, with Japanese translation provided including subtitles. Closed Roundtable sessions operate under the Chatham House Rule.

Ethereum is the most accessible public blockchain in the world — and, in fact, the world’s largest stablecoin network. Yet one challenge remains: to institutional investors, it can look “too public.” What will it take, right now, for more institutional assets to be built and put to work on Ethereum? That is the missing piece of the puzzle — and this summit exists to confront it head-on: the future in which institutions run on Ethereum.

name: Boston DAO Converge: Crypto, AI & the Future of Agentic Finance
description:
Converge is one afternoon built to do a single thing: get every corner of crypto into the same room and pointed at the same questions. Policy, stablecoins, and AI. None of them belong to any one chain.

This is what ETHBoston and Solana Boston become in 2026. Same organizers, same standard, no longer split by ecosystem.

## On stage:

• Coinbase on x402 and agentic onchain payments
• Fidelity recording the FCAT Crypto Brief live
• Circle Research on privacy in payments
• Blockworks Research on the Token Transparency Framework
• SEC, the CFTC, and state fight over perpetuals
• Allora Labs on AI, pricing, and trading digital assets
• Quip on post-quantum security
• Lightning talks, short-format pitches from builders across the afternoon
• Groma on real estate tokenization
• A policy panel on market structure legislation and what passes before the midterms
• More to come!

## Three questions worth an afternoon

Stablecoins. The most boring and most consequential thing in crypto. Payment rails, treasury operations, bank integration, and what actually changes when dollars settle instantly and globally by default. Boston has a real claim on this one.

AI. Agents are starting to hold keys, move value, and make decisions without a human in the loop. Agentic finance is the part of the AI story that runs on crypto rails, and it is arriving well ahead of the frameworks built for it.

Policy. Market structure legislation is moving and the midterms are months away. The rules being written right now decide what everyone else in the room is allowed to build. We are putting candidates, officeholders, counsel, and advocates into sessions with the founders they regulate.

Additional programming spans DeFi, security, infrastructure, and market structure.

## Why Boston

Boston is where crypto meets institutional capital. Fidelity, Circle, Coinbase, Castle Island Ventures, and Accomplice all operate here, and MIT, Harvard, BU, and Northeastern feed a steady pipeline of founders and engineers into the ecosystem. Very few cities have both. Converge is the room where the two sides actually meet.

Converge is part of Boston Fintech Week, which puts this audience in front of the city's traditional finance and fintech crowd, and puts that crowd in front of you.

## The room

Builders beside investors. Startups beside institutions. Students beside operators. Two stages on the 16th and 17th floors of Foley Hoag's conference center at 155 Seaport Blvd, with dedicated sponsor and networking space and harbor views.

## After the sessions

The Converge after-party runs at Cisco Brewers Seaport in the open-air bungalow lounge, a short walk from the venue.

## 2026 Sponsors

Platinum

• Fidelity FCAT
• Foley Hoag

Gold

• Quip Network
• Groma
• Stand with Crypto

Silver

• Yearn

Sponsorship for 2026 is still open; reach out to us!

## Presented by The Boston DAO

The Boston DAO has run this city's independent crypto conferences since 2019. ETHBoston in 2019, 2023, 2024, and 2025. Solana Boston in 2024 and 2025, the first Solana city conference held anywhere. Converge is the two of them, merged.

name: Monad Blitz Berlin Hackathon
description:
Monad Blitz is coming to Berlin!

Monad Blitz is the longest running vibe-coding web3 hackathon where builders ship fast, learn by doing, and plug directly into the Monad ecosystem. Since launching in May 2025, we’ve taken 50+ editions of this high-energy one-day hackathon concept across the globe. Shanghai to San Francisco. Lagos to Lisbon.

This isn’t just a hackathon. It’s a direct line into the heart of the Monad ecosystem, putting you in the same room as the founders, builders, and investors pushing it forward every day.

Whether you're a seasoned onchain builder, a founder looking to ship something new, or a Web2 dev crypto-curious for the first time — Blitz is the best environment for you to experiment on Monad.

What to expect:

• A full day of focused building on Monad's high performance EVM.
• $3,000 USD in prizes
• Organic collisions with developers actively building in the ecosystem
• A tight-knit builder community that ships fast and has fun doing it

THE FLOW

• Learn: Morning workshops and hands-on mentoring to get you up to speed on Monad.
• Build: 7 hours of high-speed execution. Form a team or go solo.
• Ship: Demo your MVP to the crowd.
• Win: Claim your share of the $3,000

Capacity is limited. Apply early to secure your spot.

THE SCHEDULE

• 9:00 AM - Registration & Breakfast
• 10:00 AM - Welcome & Monad Blitz Introduction
• 10:15 AM - Monad 101 Workshop
• 11:15 AM - Hacking Begins
• 1:00 PM - Lunch
• 5:00 PM - Code Freeze
• 5:30 PM - Submission Deadline
• 6:00 PM - Pitches
• 7:30 PM - Prizes, Networking & Closing Remarks

About Monad (https://www.monad.xyz/?utm_source=luma)

Monad is a highly performant and EVM compatible layer 1 blockchain. Re-inventing from the ground up, the innovations in both consensus and execution make it possible to achieve throughput up to 10,000 transactions per second (TPS).

About Monad Blitz

Monad Blitz is a high-energy, one-day hackathon series designed to empower builders on Monad’s high-performance EVM. We’ve traveled from Shenzhen to San Francisco, bringing together developers to learn, squad up, and ship real projects in a single day. With thousands of participants and hundreds of prototypes shipped to date, Blitz is the ultimate venue for fast execution and high-throughput results. Whether you're an EVM veteran or just starting out, this is your invitation to build the future on Monad.

Encode Club is London's leading community for founders and builders in AI and Web3. With weekly events, hackathons, and accelerator programmes, and the Encode Hub (https://hub.encodeclub.com/) coworking space in Shoreditch, it's where ambitious founders come to learn, connect, and grow.

Blockchain infrastructure and stablecoins are now offering an alternative. Not as a disruption from outside, but increasingly as a layer that banks, PSPs, and fintechs are building into their own architectures.

During this exclusive morning, we'll bring together banks, PSPs, trade finance players and fintechs to examine where this rebuild is already happening, what it takes to integrate blockchain and stablecoin infrastructure at scale, and who the real winners of the new payment stack will be.

Thanks to Payward Services, SG Forge, 21X, BNP Paribas, and DFNS for making this event possible. Attending? Share your presence with a dedicated visual here! (https://breakfasts.thebigwhale.io/#miami-september29)

Hosted by Solidus Labs and Yulchon, this in-person session will focus on advancing global crypto compliance through practical discussion. Agenda

16:30 – Registration

• Tokenization and Implementation of the amended Capital Markets Act and Electronic Securities Act
  • How the recently enacted framework will be implemented in practice, including issuance, distribution and the treatment of investment contract securities.
    • Speaker:  Ik Hyun Kim, Partner at Yulchon leading the blockchain and digital assets practice

  • Korea’s planned extension of the Travel Rule to transfers below KRW 1 million

name: Convergence: Onchain Finance Soirée at Sibos Miami | OpenZeppelin x WisdomTree x DFNS
description:
Convergence is a curated evening soirée during Sibos Miami 2026, hosted by OpenZeppelin, WisdomTree, and DFNS, for the leaders bringing traditional finance onchain.

Finance is moving onchain. Tokenized funds, stablecoins, digital custody, and onchain settlement are becoming part of institutional infrastructure, and the people building that shift rarely get a room of their own at a conference of 10,000.

This evening is that room: banks, asset managers, payment networks, capital markets infrastructure, fintechs and neobanks, alongside the teams securing and powering their move onchain. Real conversations, away from the noise of the conference floor.

Join us on Wednesday, September 30 for cocktails in a private venue surrounded by modern art, 4 minutes from the Miami Beach Convention Center (MBCC).

Previous Convergence events drew senior guests from firms including J.P. Morgan, Citi, UBS, Morgan Stanley, Bank of America, BNY, Fidelity, Mastercard, Deloitte, and more.

The evening is limited to 100 guests to keep it at conversation scale. Registration is subject to hosts' approval.

## About the hosts

OpenZeppelin (https://www.openzeppelin.com/) is the security standard for onchain finance. Since 2015, its industry-standard smart contracts library has powered $37 trillion in value transferred, alongside 900+ security engagements for leading institutions, blockchain networks, and protocols including DTCC, Fidelity Digital Assets, WisdomTree, Aave, the Canton Foundation and the Ethereum Foundation. Learn more at openzeppelin.com (https://openzeppelin.com).

WisdomTree (https://www.wisdomtree.com/corporate) is a global financial innovator offering a diverse suite of exchange-traded products, models, digital assets, and solutions. A pioneer in bringing regulated tokenized funds to market, WisdomTree is building the bridge between traditional asset management and onchain finance.

Dfns (http://dfns.co/?utm_source=luma) is the leading Wallets-as-a-Service (WaaS) platform to manage digital asset operations and build applications onchain. Dfns is trusted by over 400 fintechs and financial institutions, including Circle, Stripe, First Abu Dhabi Bank, Standard Chartered Bank, Apex, Susquehanna, MoonPay, Fidelity, and many others.

📸 Event Photography

We'll be capturing photos and videos throughout the event. By attending, you agree that we may use event content (including your image) in our marketing materials, social media, and future promotions. If you prefer not to be photographed, please let us know at check-in.

Registration details may be shared with event co-hosts WisdomTree and Dfns for event coordination.

Solana Summit Korea는 한국의 스테이블코인, 규제 프레임워크, 그리고 자본시장의 미래를 그려나갈 기관 중심의 Invite-only 컨퍼런스입니다. 기관 리더, 정책 입안자, 규제 당국, 그리고 디지털 자산 분야를 개척하는 선구자들을 모십니다.

• 기관 PoC 쇼케이스: 솔라나 재단과 국내 주요 금융기관이 공동 구축한 개념검증(PoC)의 라이브 시연
• 최고 수준의 네트워킹: 메인 컨퍼런스 홀과 분리된 네트워킹 공간 및 프라이빗 오찬

• 기관: 디지털 자산 관련 실질적 과제를 추진 중인 상업은행, 자산운용사, 증권사, 핀테크의 임원급 리더
• 정책 입안자 및 규제 당국: 한국의 스테이블코인 및 디지털 자산 입법 프레임워크를 설계하는 관계자 및 자문위원
• 디지털 자산 선구자: 스테이블코인, RWA, 기관용 DeFi에 집중하는 솔라나 생태계 내 창업자 및 핵심 인프라 구축자

Rather than a one-way panel, this is built for genuine exchange among people solving the same problems. name: Agentic Money 2026
description:
## AGENTIC MONEY 2026

## When Intelligence Moves Value — Global Payments & Onchain Finance

A new financial landscape is taking shape in 2026—one in which agents are becoming economic actors, capable of participating in payments, trading, and treasury operations.

Four layers are beginning to converge:

Agents decide. Payment networks move value. Onchain finance provides assets and liquidity. LLM tokens measure and price model usage.

That is why Money in Motion (https://x.com/moneyinmotion26) and LongTree Labs (https://x.com/LongTreeLabs) are co-hosting the inaugural Agentic Money Summit during TOKEN2049 Singapore Week, with PhotonPay (https://x.com/PhotonPay), DogPay (https://x.com/DogPay_), United Stables (https://x.com/UTechStables) , AWS, Eddid (https://www.eddid.com.hk/en), Interlace (https://x.com/InterlaceMoney), FluxA (https://x.com/FluxA_Official) and StableTree  (https://x.com/stabletree_ai)as our first announced partners.

> 🔗Official Website：https://moneyinmotion.xyz/token2049/agenticmoney2026/
> 🤝Partnership and sponsorship inquiries: https://t.me/Mix_Web3

Together, we will explore the question at the center of this emerging system:

When agents can move money, access liquidity, and transact across global markets, how must the financial system evolve?

## What We Will Explore

## Panel 1｜Agentic Payments

How can agents gain verifiable, controllable capabilities for payments and treasury operations?

## Panel 2｜Global Trade Corridors

How can stablecoins and local payment networks reshape collections, acquiring, settlement, and clearing in emerging markets?

## Panel 3｜RWA at Scale

From Asset Issuance to Distribution & Liquidity

## Panel 4｜IWhen Wall Street Goes Onchain

Tokenized Equities, Clearing & AI Composability

## The Questions That Connect the Panels

The most important opportunities—and the hardest design choices—appear where these four conversations intersect:

• When an agent manages assets, initiates payments, and executes transactions on behalf of an individual or a business, how should the financial system identify it, and where should the boundaries of permission and responsibility be drawn?
• When card networks, account-to-account payments, and stablecoin networks are all available, how will an agent choose its payment and settlement route?
• Can stablecoin liquidity accumulated through cross-border payments become a source of capital for trading, financing, and collateralization across U.S. equities and RWAs?
• As U.S. equities and other RWAs move onchain, which trading, financing, and collateral operations can agents automate, and where should their permission boundaries be drawn?
• When agents purchase models, data, and compute, LLM tokens measure usage while stablecoins settle payments. Will these two layers remain separate, or will model usage credits emerge that can be traded and settled directly?

## Build the Next Financial System

No single industry can answer these questions alone. Agentic Money 2026 will bring agent and AI product teams, payment institutions, stablecoin infrastructure providers, onchain asset platforms, liquidity providers, model services, banks, compliance organizations, investors, and researchers into the same room.

We want these conversations to lead to concrete outcomes: a new payment rail, an asset that agents can access programmatically, a partner for entering a new market, a clearer rule for managing risk, or a problem worth years of work.

We hope the most important questions, the most experienced practitioners, and the most promising directions can meet here first—and grow into real products, market connections, and long-term partnerships.

AGENTIC MONEY 2026 is an invitation to explore how the next financial system will work—and to help build it together.

We look forward to welcoming you to AGENTIC MONEY 2026 in Singapore.

name: The Real Yield Happy Hour by HoneyB
description:
For much of DeFi’s history, “yield” was fueled by token incentives, emissions, and liquidity mining. High APYs attracted capital, but too often the yield disappeared when the incentives stopped.

That is changing.

Credit, equities, Treasuries, ETFs, and institutional income strategies are moving onchain, bringing yield generated by real economic activity into DeFi. Interest paid by borrowers. Dividends from companies. Income from public markets. Cash flows that exist beyond token incentives.

As TradFi and DeFi converge, onchain yield is evolving from something created for crypto into a new distribution layer for the world's income-producing assets.

As the saying goes: "If you don’t know where the yield is coming from, you are the yield.”

Join HoneyB for drinks and a conversation about the next generation of real yield and onchain capital markets.

## 关于 BiNet｜全域资产交易网络

BiNet 是 BiFu 打造的全域资产交易网络，也是「One Account, Trade the World」这句承诺的底层支撑。

它将加密资产、外汇、大宗商品、股票、RWA 与预测市场六大类市场整合进统一账户体系。用户只需完成一次身份认证，即可用同一个账户、同一笔资金进入全部市场。

在这套体系之下，BiNet 以统一身份、统一资金、统一风控、统一合规四项基础能力为骨架，辅以聚合 200 余家全球交易所的流动性网络、亚毫秒级交易引擎与智能路由，让跨市场交易像在单一市场中一样连贯、顺畅。

资产之间的墙正在被拆除，BiNet 要做的，就是把全球市场装进一个账户。

## 关于 BiFu 财富板块｜BiFu Wealth

## RWA 的价值不只在于资产上链，更在于让普通投资者真正有机会参与其中。

BiFu 财富板块面向既有稳健收益诉求、又希望保留资金灵活性的用户，提供一站式资产配置入口。依托 BiNet 的统一账户与跨市场基础设施，RWA 将与加密资产、外汇、大宗商品共同构成多元资产配置体系。

通过将真实世界资产引入链上配置框架，财富板块让过去仅向机构开放的收益来源，逐步成为普通投资者可触达、可理解、可配置的选项。

让 RWA 从行业热词变成普通投资者账户里的真实持仓，这是 BiFu 财富板块对「金融平权」的回答，也是我们对「RWA 真正落地」这个命题给出的实践。

## RWA Beyond the Hype: What Will Real Adoption Take?

RWA no longer lacks attention. The more important question now is how real-world assets can become products that users understand, trust, and choose to use—and how those products can reach meaningful scale.

On the evening of October 7, BiFu invites you to join “RWA Beyond the Hype: What Will Real Adoption Take?”, an evening of industry talks and networking. Following the VIP Private Dinner, the venue will transition into a more open and dynamic second event, welcoming a broader group of RWA builders, partners, and industry peers.

The reception will feature concise talks from selected partners, alongside live performances, drinks, and open networking. After a full day at TOKEN2049, this is a chance to talk about the projects currently being built, the problems teams are working through, and where future collaboration may begin.

Capacity is limited and registrations are subject to approval. Final admission will be based on registration confirmation and venue capacity.

> For business enquiries, please contact: connect@bifu.co

## Agenda

20:00–20:20 Guest arrival, welcome drinks, and networking

20:20–20:55 Opening remarks and selected partner/project spotlights

20:55–21:50 Live performance and open networking

21:50–22:00 Second lucky draw, closing remarks

## Who Is in the Room

Founders and co-founders of RWA and Web3 projects, ecosystem and growth leads, trading platforms and financial infrastructure teams, BiFu partners, KOLs and content creators, professional community leaders, as well as media, researchers, investors, and members of Singapore’s FinTech and Web3 ecosystem.

## Host: BiFu

Founded in 2023, BiFu is a pioneering platform connecting Web2 and Web3 markets through unified, multi-asset trading.

BiFu is a unified asset network connecting digital assets with the broader global financial markets. By breaking down traditional market boundaries, BiFu enables users to access Crypto, foreign exchange, commodities, US and Hong Kong equities, and RWA through a single account.

Supported by a unified account system, fast and stable performance, a comprehensive compliance framework, and community participation, BiFu is working to make global wealth opportunities more accessible—so that wherever an opportunity appears, users are already there.

## About BiNet｜The Unified Asset Trading Network

BiNet is the unified asset trading network developed by BiFu and the infrastructure behind the promise: “One Account, Trade the World.”

It brings six market categories—Crypto, foreign exchange, commodities, equities, RWA, and prediction markets—into one unified account system. With a single identity verification process, users can access these markets through the same account and the same pool of funds.

BiNet is built on four core capabilities: unified identity, unified funds, unified risk management, and unified compliance. Together with a liquidity network aggregating more than 200 global exchanges, a sub-millisecond trading engine, and intelligent routing, this infrastructure is designed to make cross-market trading as continuous and straightforward as trading within a single market.

The walls between asset classes are coming down. BiNet’s goal is to bring global markets into one account.

## About BiFu Wealth

The value of RWA lies not only in bringing assets on-chain, but in giving everyday investors a real opportunity to participate.

BiFu Wealth is designed for users seeking steady return opportunities while retaining the flexibility to respond to changing markets. It provides a single entry point for diversified asset allocation. Supported by BiNet’s unified account and cross-market infrastructure, RWA sits alongside Crypto, foreign exchange, and commodities within a broader multi-asset portfolio framework.

By bringing real-world assets into an on-chain allocation framework, BiFu Wealth is making sources of return that were once available mainly to institutions increasingly accessible, understandable, and investable for everyday users.

Turning RWA from an industry buzzword into a real holding in an everyday investor’s account is BiFu Wealth’s answer to financial inclusion—and our practical response to what it means to bring RWA into real-world adoption.

name: A Global Living Lab: Light DAO's Next International Gathering
description:
Members of Light DAO’s leadership recently participated in Edge Esmeralda and came away feeling it was one of the most impressive, inspiring and transformative business gatherings we had ever experienced — because it was not a conference, retreat or summit.

It was a Society Incubator — an extraordinary integration of worlds that are rarely found in one place.

In a single day, you might:

🌅 Begin the morning with a tea ceremony, breathwork or yoga

🧠 Move into a talk with brilliant researchers, founders and investors on frontier science and emerging technology

💻 Spend a few hours building software, testing experimental health wearables, collaborating in a maker space, or creating in a media lab

🌿 Head into nature, join a wellness session, or get absorbed in a discussion on the latest in AI agents, fintech or longevity

🍽️ Continue the conversations over dinner late into the evening — or end the night with music, ecstatic dance or a calming sound bath

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 For families, dedicated programs for kids and teens, starting at age 4, offer opportunities to play, learn, create and build within their own community

✨ Alongside all of this are deep conversations about consciousness, philosophy, society and human flourishing

It felt like stepping into a living laboratory for the future — a temporary village designed to explore and experiment with how we might live, work, learn, build and thrive differently.

It offered a glimpse of what the world could look like when innovation, human flourishing and community are developed together.

## This is Edge City.

Edge Cities are 3–4 week Living Labs and Society Incubators — international popup villages where frontier technology, science, entrepreneurship, consciousness, culture, art, well-being and community are not separate tracks, but part of one shared environment.

Edge Cities have already taken place in Patagonia, Chiang Mai, Cape Town and Esmeralda, two hours north of San Francisco.

Edge Esmeralda — June 2026

• 850 residents from 60+ countries
• Nearly 300 stayed for the full month
• 800+ sessions and experiments
• Families came with 48 kids

What made it so extraordinary was being surrounded by brilliant, conscious innovators genuinely committed to advancing humanity — with enough time together for real relationships, collaborations and radical ideas to develop.

www.EdgeEsmeralda.com (https://www.EdgeEsmeralda.com)

That experience convinced us that Edge City offers something unusually valuable for the Light DAO community.

So this October, we’re taking our community to the next Edge City.

## 🌴 The Next Edge City: Goa, India

October 11 – November 1, 2026

We’re taking our community to Edge India in Goa — a three-week Living Lab and Society Incubator with hundreds of participants, approximately 65% coming from outside India.

Light DAO will have our own RESIDENCY within the larger Edge India community, so our members can take part in the full Edge experience while also connecting more intimately with our own community.

## 💡 A Living Lab Created by Its Community

One of the things that makes Edge Cities especially unique and powerful is its unconference-style format. Much of the experience is created by the participants themselves — through the talks, demos, experiments and working groups they lead around the ideas and projects they care most about.

Light DAO will also host more intimate gatherings within our own Residency, led by our guests.

Once registered, Light DAO Owner Members are welcome to contact us with ideas you might like to lead or contribute to. We can’t guarantee a place in either the Light DAO or Edge programming, but we’d love to hear what you are most excited to share.

That participatory spirit is part of what makes Edge a true Living Lab: the community does not simply attend the experience — it helps create it.

## 🤝 A Special Light DAO + SingularityNET  Residency

We’re delighted to be partnering with SingularityNET for a 3-week Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency at Edge India. This is the first collaboration of its kind we’ve run with the SingularityNET team.

Everyone racing toward AGI is making the same bet: that a bigger model gets there. SingularityNET is not.

Led by Dr. Ben Goertzel, who launched the term and concept of Artificial General Intelligence, the team scales Beneficial General Intelligence on Hyperon, a cognitive architecture with two decades of research behind it. It holds knowledge, goals and decisions in a form you can inspect, shows its reasoning, and runs under explicit permissions — which is what makes it deployable inside real institutions.

The residency puts you in the room with the people building it. Talks, working sessions and open build time for developers, founders, researchers, investors, and anyone serious about AGI, ASI and beneficial technology.

Bring what you are already building. Leave with something concrete: a technical integration, a partnership, an investment conversation, or a prototype you put together on-site at Edge India.

## Why Join the Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency?

In addition to the full Edge India experience, our Residency gives you a more intimate community to connect, collaborate and build with throughout your stay, including:

🤖 Light DAO + SingularityNET talks, working sessions and open build time

💬 More intimate conversations and collaborations within our residency group, particularly with SingularityNET's leadership and tech team.

🍽️ Light DAO-organized meals, including opportunities for participants to lead topic conversations

🌴 Optional group outings and shared experiences

🎤 Opportunities for Light DAO Owner Members to propose topics they may want to lead or contribute to

🏖️ A shared home base at our beachfront resort

Think of our residency as your home community within the larger Edge India Living Lab.

## What Makes Edge Cities a Unique Living Lab + Society Incubator

Hear Edge Cities co-founder Timour Kosters talk about the multidisciplinary, multigenerational and global vision behind Edge Cities — including its unconference format and experiments.

He shares how the experience stretches people’s sense of what is possible, helps them embody that expansion, and activates new collaborations and directions. In 1–3 weeks, many participants accelerate results that might otherwise have taken months or longer.

The Edge experience is designed around focused work, collaboration, wellness, community and time to enjoy Goa.

Your Edge Pass includes the full Edge India experience — programming, coworking, wellness, community gatherings and more.

name: XRP LEDGER HACKATHON
description:
Sprint, build, and launch on the XRP Ledger in 36 hours in New York City, the weekend before Swell (https://swell.ripple.com/).

Hosted by XRPL Commons (https://www.xrpl-commons.org), this hackathon brings hackers into the room where the ecosystem's institutions, investors, and decision-makers are already gathered — with a project and a story to tell. Whether this is your first commit on XRP Ledger or you've been building for years, there's a track for you.

## 4 Tracks

• Protocol Innovation: work on the ledger itself: amendments, client implementations, tooling. Paired with a 3-day Core Dev Bootcamp (Oct 20–22) (http://luma.com/xrpl-core-dev-bootcamp2) as your on-ramp.
• Agentic Finance: build the rails that let autonomous agents transact on-chain safely and at machine speed.
• Lending & Borrowing: build on top of the XRP Ledger Lending Protocol (XLS-66) and Single Asset Vaults (XLS-65), currently in validator voting.
• Why Not: the open lane, for whatever XRP Ledger project you can't stop thinking about.

## Already Building?

Bring an existing project — on XRP Ledger or elsewhere — and use the 36 hours to add XRPL rails or ship a new feature. Only what you build during the hackathon counts toward judging.

Should the event be oversubscribed, we may ask attendees to place a small refundable deposit to confirm their spot.

All participants are required to agree with and adhere to the code of conduct (https://swell.ripple.com/code-of-conduct)

description:
Join us for the London edition of the PR1ME Series, during Solana Breakpoint (https://solana.com/breakpoint) powered by the Onchain Finance Institute (OCF), Solana Foundation (https://solana.org/), Lukka (https://lukka.tech/) and Breezing (https://breezing.io/).

This invite only, community driven gathering brings together leading minds in web3 accounting and finance.

This event is exclusively for finance professionals - CFOs, COOs, Controllers, Heads of Finance, or equivalent. We're unable to accept applications outside these roles.

Important: Only confirmed guests with a QR code will be allowed entry. Please note that walk-ins or unapproved registrations will not be possible.

## About Solana Foundation

The Solana Foundation (https://solana.org/) is a non-profit organisation based in Zug, Switzerland, dedicated to the decentralisation, growth, and security of the Solana network. Solana is a proof-of-stake blockchain built for mass adoption. Fast, composable, green, and globally distributed.

## About Lukka

Lukka (https://lukka.tech/) is the institutional data backbone for digital assets, transforming fragmented on-chain and off-chain activity into audit-ready intelligence. Trusted by global financial institutions, asset managers, custodians, exchanges, and regulators, Lukka delivers the trust, truth, and transparency needed to power pricing, valuation, compliance, risk management, accounting, and reporting across digital and tokenized assets.

## About Breezing

Breezing (https://breezing.io/) is a crypto subledger built specifically for accounting professionals managing digital assets. It connects directly to blockchains, exchanges, and accounting systems like Xero and QuickBooks, eliminating the manual work of exporting CSVs and posting journal entries by hand.

Used by 200+ businesses including ht.digital (https://ht.digital), BDO, ETH Global, Safe, and Dune.

SOC 2 certified and Swiss-made🇨🇭.

## About Onchain Finance Institute (OCF)

Onchain Finance Institute (OCF) (https://www.onchainfinanceinstitute.com/) is an education and community platform helping finance professionals build real-world onchain finance skills for accounting, treasury, and finance roles.

Join 150+ alumni and 400+ community members from organizations such as Solana Foundation, a16z, Ava Labs, Starknet, and more, upskilling with digital assets and transitioning into the future of onchain finance.

Apply to join community platform (https://www.onchainfinanceinstitute.com/community).

name: Cardano node diversity celebration day
description:
One network. Many builders. A stronger future.

Cardano node diversity is no longer just an ambition. It is becoming real.

On the 6th October in Singapore, Cardano Diversity Celebration Day will bring together representatives from Cardano’s different node implementations to share their progress, compare timelines and discuss how independent implementations can strengthen the network. The event will also introduce the Diversity Ambassador Program and invite feedback on the next phase of this collective effort.

Why does this matter? Because a truly resilient blockchain should never depend on one team, one codebase or one way of solving a problem. Independent node implementations give Cardano more protection, more opportunities for innovation and more freedom to evolve.

Node diversity reduces common-mode risk: when implementations are developed independently, they can reveal different edge cases, validate protocol behaviour from different perspectives. It also creates room for improvements in resource efficiency, observability, tooling and operator experience.

This is not about replacing one implementation with another. It is about building complementary infrastructure—giving Cardano more resilience, more engineering options and greater confidence as the protocol evolves.

Cardano Diversity Celebration Day is where the people building that future come together and where the wider community gets to see what comes next

The event will be broadcasted from Singapore but everyone is welcome to join us online.

More information about the even: https://hackmd.io/@Amaru/DiversityCelebrationDraft

Agenda:

• Why diversity matters: decentralization, security and resilience
• Node implementers progress update and timelines (every Cardano node implementer representative will give an overview of their project)
• Amaru incoming initiative: Cardano diversity ambassador program, 2027 Amaru proposal first ideas

name: The Capital Summit x Asia Stablecoin Conference
description:
## What Is Shaping Asia’s Digital Asset Market Structure?

Stablecoins and tokenized assets are developing differently across Korea, Japan, Hong Kong, Singapore, Southeast Asia, and the UAE—reflecting each market’s regulatory, monetary, and capital-market structure.

The next phase will require more than issuance. It will require a complete institutional market structure supporting the full asset lifecycle:

Issuance → Investment → Distribution → Secondary-Market Liquidity → Independent Assessment

The Singapore edition of The Capital Summit x Asia Stablecoin Conference will focus on five areas:

1. Stablecoin Issuance — Which models can scale across Asia?
2. Tokenization — Which Asian assets will attract global investors?
3. Secondary Markets — Where will tokenized assets trade?
4. Distribution — How will institutions bring these assets to market?
5. Ratings — What frameworks will investors require?

name: Institutional Onchain Finance Summit 2026
description:
Connecting Financial Institutions, Stablecoins & Digital Asset Infrastructure

Hosted by Cregis · FOMO Pay  · Stable · Width
Partner: Tether· MetaComp · 1exchange · CapBridge · CertiK · ZAN ·HackenProof · Stablecoin Insider · Activ8

## About the Summit

Onchain finance is becoming increasingly connected with the global financial system.

Stablecoins are moving into payments and settlement, financial institutions are exploring new forms of digital money and tokenized assets, and digital asset security is evolving beyond technology alone to encompass infrastructure, governance and day-to-day operations.

Taking place in Singapore during TOKEN2049 Week, the Institutional Onchain Finance Summit 2026 brings together senior leaders and decision-makers from financial institutions, payments, fintech, stablecoins, digital assets, compliance, security and investment.

Through keynotes, panel discussions and curated networking, the summit provides a focused setting for industry leaders to exchange perspectives on how institutional onchain finance is taking shape today — and what comes next.

## What We'll Discuss

Panel I

What Stablecoins Mean for Banks, Businesses & the Wider Economy

Stablecoins are beginning to reshape how money is held, moved and settled across the global economy. As adoption expands, their impact is extending beyond digital assets into banking, corporate finance, cross-border commerce and access to major currencies.

This panel will explore where stablecoins can improve existing financial services, how banks, payment companies and businesses may participate in the emerging ecosystem, and what wider adoption could mean for liquidity, competition and the movement of money across markets.

Panel II

The New Security Playbook: How Attacks & Defenses Are Evolving Across Digital Assets

Digital asset attacks are increasingly moving beyond code vulnerabilities into infrastructure, identities and operational processes. At the same time, automation, interconnected systems and AI are changing both how attacks are scaled and how threats are detected.

This panel will explore how the security playbook is evolving across smart contracts, signing systems, third-party infrastructure and human workflows — and what organizations need to rethink across prevention, monitoring and incident response.

name: The Clearing House II: Singapore
description:
## 🔷 Welcome to the Second Edition of The Clearing House

After a successful inaugural event in Cannes (https://x.com/MidasRWA/status/2038966272126308742?s=20) that introduced The Clearing House experience, we are looking forward to hosting the second edition on October 6th, 2026 in Singapore, during Token2049. The premise stays the same:

Events and summits have become too noisy for the people actually building.

This is why Midas created The Clearing House, a curated event series for the architects of onchain financial markets. We bring together the primary sources for an invite-only session focused on the real advancement of tokenisation, lending and asset management. No fluff, no wasted time, just the conversations that move the needle.

## 📥 Invitation Only

To ensure a high-signal environment, this is a private event. Attendance is strictly limited and accessible only to approved guests.

## 🤝 Who Will Be There?

A curated assembly of leaders across onchain investing, tokenization, lending and asset management.

• Lending Markets
• Asset Managers
• Risk Curators
• LPs & Allocators
• DeFi Protocols

## 📍 Venue

Join us for skyline views and fully catered premium food and drinks at an exclusive rooftop venue in the heart of Singapore - right besides the Marina Sands Bay. Exact location will be available to approved guests only.

## ⏳ Format

We value your time as much as you do. This isn't another conference mixer; it’s an intentional space designed to turn virtual relationships into real-world partnerships.

• Zero Noise: No crowded rooms or generic pitches. We focus on high-signal networking that advances business deals and moves the needle for onchain finance.
• One Panel: A single, focused panel discussion moderated by Dennis Dinkelmeyer, CEO of Midas, featuring a selection of industry leaders. We keep the stage time short so you can spend the rest of the evening with the people who matter.
• The Right Room: Every guest is hand-picked to ensure you are surrounded by decision-makers, not event tourists.

## 🌍 The Clearing House: 2026 Roadmap

The Clearing House debuted earlier this year in Cannes (https://x.com/MidasRWA/status/2038966272126308742?s=20). Singapore is our second edition, timed around Token2049. We are building a continuous, high-signal network across the globe, so the industry's key decision-makers always have the right room to connect.

After Singapore, expect us to bring this curated experience to:

• The Clearing House III: London during Breakpoint Solana, Nov 16, 2026

## 🏙️ Hosted By Midas

Midas (https://www.midas.app) is a platform for composable onchain investment products. It gives investors exposure to institutional strategies — which are run by professional strategy managers — through its performance-linked mTokens. These tokens offer full transparency, instant redemptions, and native composability across DeFi. To date, Midas has powered over $2B in asset issuance and paid out $46M in yield.

We have more than a 8 year successful track record and we are focused solely on managing portfolios of crypto assets and strategies on behalf of wholesale investors, family offices and fund of funds.

Through its evolved approach to onchain yield, the firm applies institutional-grade credit underwriting to construct, monitor, and manage diversified exposure across stablecoin and real-world asset strategies.

name: Token Sale Summit 2026 @ Token2049 Singapore
description:
Join us for an exclusive Token Sale Summit during Token2049 Singapore, designed for founders, C-suites and project leaders preparing a token sale (TGE) or rethinking their launch plan for today's market.

Token sales in 2026 work differently from previous cycles. A successful raise now runs as one connected launch, in which the private and public rounds, TGE, exchange listings and post-listing market making each serve a distinct purpose and are planned together to support the token's success after launch day.

In this invite-only session, our TokenMinds expert team will share practical strategies for this new environment.

📅 Date: Wednesday, October 7, 2026 (during Token2049 Sigapore)
🕔 Time: 3:00 PM - 4:00 PM (SGT)
📍 Location: Singapore
🎟️ Admission: Free (RSVP required)*

*Attendance will be carefully curated, please register to be considered.

## Key Takeaways

• Token Sale setup for 2026, including round structure (private to public route), tokenomics, whitepaper, legal framework and more
• Choosing, and getting selected for, the right launchpads and platforms under today's stricter vetting and compliance
• Token Sale marketing strategies for a more selective market
• Post-TGE liquidity, listings & market engagement

## Why now

Token sale has become more selective now. Exchanges, launchpads and regulators ask sharper questions about sale terms, token rights and unlock schedules, and retail buyers do the same. This session helps you finalize a launch plan that holds up under that scrutiny before the year-end window closes.

## Hosted by TokenMinds

TokenMinds is an award-winning blockchain and AI firm that has run token sales since 2017, supporting 150+ projects through the ICO boom, the IEO/IDO phase, DeFi Summer, the NFT wave and today's launchpad era. TokenMinds provides end-to-end support, from concept and implementation to advisory and maintenance. TokenMinds ensures comprehensive solutions by combining strategic engineering, creative approach, and market analysis. It has been recognized as a leading Web3 and AI company by renowned organizations such as Hackernoon, Metapress, Coinranking, and more.

Important Notes: This is an exclusive summit with a curated guest list. Registration does not guarantee admission; approvals will be sent to selected attendees.

name: RWA Beyond the Hype: VIP Private Dinner
description:
## 超越热度：RWA 真正落地，还缺什么？

在 TOKEN2049 的第一天夜晚，BiFu 设宴做东，我们邀请 BiFu VIP 及行业嘉宾参与「超越热度：RWA 真正落地，还缺什么？」VIP 私享晚宴。

2026年 TOKEN2049 首日活动结束后，BiFu 来请你吃饭。我们邀请 BiFu VIP 及行业嘉宾参与「超越热度：RWA 真正落地，还缺什么？」VIP 私享晚宴。

放下白天的展会的匆忙和喧嚣，我们希望用一顿丰盛的高级自助晚餐与美酒款待。作为新一代全域资产交易网络，BiFu 期待在这场定向邀请的闭门晚宴中，与 RWA 核心建设者、资本及基础设施代表相聚，共同探讨资产产品化与真实流动的实现路径。

本次活动采用邀请制入场，为嘉宾提供高密度、私密的行业连接，您若认为自己属于被邀请的，请填写报名信息，我们审核后会联系您。

> 如有商务或合作需求，请联系 connect@bifu.co (https://mailto:connect@bifu.co)，或telegram @takshire

## 时间流程｜Agenda

• 17:00–17:30　嘉宾签到、欢迎酒与自由交流
• 17:30–18:10　主持开场、自助晚餐与相互认识
• 18:15–18:45　BiFu CEO、产品负责人及特邀嘉宾分享／主题对谈
• 18:45–19:12　继续用餐、自由交流与第一轮抽奖
• 19:12–19:50　现场表演与集体合影
• 19:50–20:00　自由交流与第二场转场

## 现场嘉宾｜Who Is in the Room

RWA 项目与资产方、交易平台与多资产平台、基金／做市商／VC、财富管理机构与家族办公室、稳定币／支付／托管／安全服务商、金融基础设施团队、新加坡 FinTech 与 Web3 生态代表，以及精选媒体、研究者与专业社群。

## 主办方｜Host：BiFu

成立于 2023 年，BiFu 是融通 Web2 与 Web3 全域资产交易的先锋级平台。

BiFu 是连接数字资产与更广泛全球市场的统一资产网络。我们打破传统金融边界，让用户只需一个账户，即可自由交易 Crypto、外汇、大宗商品、美港股及 RWA。凭借统一账户体系、极速稳定性能、完备合规与社区赋能，BiFu 致力于让全球优质财富走向平权，确保无论机会出现在哪个市场，用户都已「在场」。

## 关于 BiNet｜全域资产交易网络

BiNet 是 BiFu 打造的全域资产交易网络，也是「One Account, Trade the World」这句承诺的底层支撑。

它将加密资产、外汇、大宗商品、股票、RWA 与预测市场六大类市场整合进统一账户体系。用户只需完成一次身份认证，即可用同一个账户、同一笔资金进入全部市场。

在这套体系之下，BiNet 以统一身份、统一资金、统一风控、统一合规四项基础能力为骨架，辅以聚合 200 余家全球交易所的流动性网络、亚毫秒级交易引擎与智能路由，让跨市场交易像在单一市场中一样连贯、顺畅。

资产之间的墙正在被拆除，BiNet 要做的，就是把全球市场装进一个账户。

## 关于 BiFu 财富板块｜BiFu Wealth

RWA 的价值不只在于资产上链，更在于让普通投资者真正有机会参与其中。

BiFu 财富板块面向既有稳健收益诉求、又希望保留资金灵活性的用户，提供一站式资产配置入口。依托 BiNet 的统一账户与跨市场基础设施，RWA 将与加密资产、外汇、大宗商品共同构成多元资产配置体系。

通过将真实世界资产引入链上配置框架，财富板块让过去仅向机构开放的收益来源，逐步成为普通投资者可触达、可理解、可配置的选项。

让 RWA 从行业热词变成普通投资者账户里的真实持仓，这是 BiFu 财富板块对「金融平权」的回答，也是我们对「RWA 真正落地」这个命题给出的实践。

## RWA Beyond the Hype: What Will Real Adoption Take?

On the first evening of TOKEN2049, dinner is on BiFu. We cordially invite BiFu VIPs and industry guests to be our guests at the VIP Private Dinner, “RWA Beyond the Hype: What Will Real Adoption Take?”

Step away from the conference buzz and let us treat you to a premium buffet and free-flowing drinks. As a next-generation unified asset trading network, BiFu is bringing together core RWA builders, capital providers, and infrastructure leaders for an intimate, closed-door discussion on the path from asset productization to real market liquidity.

This exclusive gathering is invite-only, offering a private setting for focused, high-value industry connections.

## Agenda

• 17:00–17:30　Guest check-in, welcome drinks, and networking
• 17:30–18:10　Opening remarks, buffet dinner, and introductions
• 18:15–18:45　Insights and featured discussion with the BiFu CEO, product lead, and invited guests
• 18:45–19:12　Dinner, networking, and the first lucky draw
• 19:12–19:50　Live performance and group photo
• 19:50–20:00　Networking and transition to the second session

## Who Is in the Room

RWA projects and asset originators; exchanges and multi-asset platforms; funds, market makers, and VCs; wealth managers and family offices; stablecoin, payment, custody, and security providers; financial infrastructure teams; representatives from Singapore’s FinTech and Web3 ecosystems; and selected media, researchers, and professional communities.

## Host: BiFu

Founded in 2023, BiFu is a pioneering platform connecting Web2 and Web3 markets through unified, multi-asset trading.

BiFu is a unified asset network connecting digital assets with the broader global financial markets. By breaking down traditional market boundaries, BiFu enables users to access Crypto, foreign exchange, commodities, US and Hong Kong equities, and RWA through a single account.

Supported by a unified account system, fast and stable performance, a comprehensive compliance framework, and community participation, BiFu is working to make global wealth opportunities more accessible—so that wherever an opportunity appears, users are already there.

## About BiNet｜The Unified Asset Trading Network

BiNet is the unified asset trading network developed by BiFu and the infrastructure behind the promise: “One Account, Trade the World.”

It brings six market categories—Crypto, foreign exchange, commodities, equities, RWA, and prediction markets—into one unified account system. With a single identity verification process, users can access these markets through the same account and the same pool of funds.

BiNet is built on four core capabilities: unified identity, unified funds, unified risk management, and unified compliance. Together with a liquidity network aggregating more than 200 global exchanges, a sub-millisecond trading engine, and intelligent routing, this infrastructure is designed to make cross-market trading as continuous and straightforward as trading within a single market.

The walls between asset classes are coming down. BiNet’s goal is to bring global markets into one account.

## About BiFu Wealth

The value of RWA lies not only in bringing assets on-chain, but in giving everyday investors a real opportunity to participate.

BiFu Wealth is designed for users seeking steady return opportunities while retaining the flexibility to respond to changing markets. It provides a single entry point for diversified asset allocation. Supported by BiNet’s unified account and cross-market infrastructure, RWA sits alongside Crypto, foreign exchange, and commodities within a broader multi-asset portfolio framework.

By bringing real-world assets into an on-chain allocation framework, BiFu Wealth is making sources of return that were once available mainly to institutions increasingly accessible, understandable, and investable for everyday users.

Turning RWA from an industry buzzword into a real holding in an everyday investor’s account is BiFu Wealth’s answer to financial inclusion—and our practical response to what it means to bring RWA into real-world adoption.

name: NEXUS Startup Competition First Round
description:
NEXUS is TOKEN2049's startup competition for early-stage crypto companies. The organizer's 2026 competition runs on 7-8 October in Singapore, with founders pitching for equity-free prizes before an expert jury and the TOKEN2049 community.

## Competition

The organizer lists a $250,000 prize pool, more than 1,000 applicants and ten finalists. The competition takes place at Marina Bay Sands during TOKEN2049 Singapore on 7-8 October. Startups must have been incorporated from 2023 onwards and raised less than $5 million in investments. Applying is free, and selection is merit-based. The jury includes Tom Schmidt (Dragonfly), Akshat Vaidya (Maelstrom) and Spencer Applebaum (Multicoin Capital).

## What finalists receive

Top ten finalists receive a complimentary startup stand, full TOKEN2049 access on 7-8 October, speaker perks including the speaker reception, networking drinks and lounge access, three complimentary team tickets, photography and session recordings, and event marketing coverage. The jury may make investment offers outside the prize grant.

## First round

The first round takes place on 7 October 2026 as part of the TOKEN2049 Singapore program at Marina Bay Sands.

## Applications

NEXUS 2026 applications closed after the 18 September deadline, with the top 50 announcement on 21 September. The organizer is accepting waitlist registrations for NEXUS 2027.
