name: The Crossing: Engineering Trust in Institutional Digital Finance
description:
An invitation-only VIP reception on the evening of TOKEN2049 Day 1, co-hosted by Safeheron, The Responsible Fintech Institute, DK Bank, Cloudflare and VerifyVASP.

Traditional finance is crossing to digital assets. Not as an experiment anymore, but as a route that has to work every time — for real money, under real rules.

No one company supplies that crossing. Between them, these five cover it end to end:

• Safeheron — the vessel. Open-source MPC and TEE self-custody, so the keys stay yours the whole way across.
• The Responsible Fintech Institute — the charts. Independent standards and published research that make the route defensible.
• DK Bank — the harbour. The official bank of Bhutan’s Gelephu Mindfulness City, built for digital assets from day one.
• Cloudflare — the lanes. The network it all runs over, reaching 95% of the world’s internet users in roughly 50 milliseconds.
• VerifyVASP — the manifest. Travel Rule at institutional scale: who is on the other end, verified before the value moves.

Five claims, and every one of them checkable.

Then drinks, canapés, and three hours with everyone else who is somewhere mid-crossing.

Places are limited. Request your invitation early.

## About Hosts

Safeheron

Safeheron is the world's leading digital asset self-custody provider. Built on fully in-house developed, open-source Secure Multi-Party Computation (MPC) and Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) technologies, Safeheron delivers institutional-grade self-custody infrastructure and industry-specific solutions at the highest security standards. Its clients span payment firms, liquidity providers (OTC), digital banks, RWA platforms, trust and asset managers, and commodity trade finance — enabling 100% client control over private keys and assets, and powering full lifecycle digital asset management, operations, and business growth.

The Responsible Fintech Institute

The Responsible Fintech Institute (RFI) is a global nonprofit organisation based in Singapore. Its goal is to create a safe, trustworthy and reliable future for digital finance by building the digital utilities that support responsible innovation. RFI brings together public and private sector stakeholders to help build the rules and technology needed for new digital financial tools, and to make the digital asset sector sustainable and inclusive.

DK Bank

DK Bank is the official bank of Bhutan’s Gelephu Mindfulness City.  DK Bank provides comprehensive financial services, including handling digital assets, and supports GMC’s ambitious development plan.

Cloudflare

Cloudflare’s network connects directly with virtually every service provider and cloud provider, reaching 95% of the world’s internet users within approximately 50 milliseconds. One of the world’s largest networks—powering all services across data centers and delivering unmatched performance, security, and reliability. Every service runs in every data center. Your users get a fast, consistent experience — everywhere.

VerifyVASP

VerifyVASP Pte. Ltd. is a leading Travel Rule solution provider delivering secure, scalable compliance infrastructure for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) worldwide. VerifyVASP offers an end-to-end compliance suite encompassing counterparty due diligence, interoperable messaging protocols, on-chain risk analytics, and advisory on Travel Rule and data protection requirements. Extending beyond compliance, VerifyVASP provides advanced solutions for global law enforcement agencies, enabling the prevention, detection, and investigation of illicit activities involving digital assets.

name: NEXUS Startup Competition Final Round
description:
NEXUS is TOKEN2049's startup competition for early-stage crypto companies. The organizer's 2026 competition runs on 7-8 October in Singapore, with founders pitching for equity-free prizes before an expert jury and the TOKEN2049 community.

## Competition

The organizer lists a $250,000 prize pool, more than 1,000 applicants and ten finalists. The competition takes place at Marina Bay Sands during TOKEN2049 Singapore on 7-8 October. Startups must have been incorporated from 2023 onwards and raised less than $5 million in investments. Applying is free, and selection is merit-based. The jury includes Tom Schmidt (Dragonfly), Akshat Vaidya (Maelstrom) and Spencer Applebaum (Multicoin Capital).

## What finalists receive

Top ten finalists receive a complimentary startup stand, full TOKEN2049 access on 7-8 October, speaker perks including the speaker reception, networking drinks and lounge access, three complimentary team tickets, photography and session recordings, and event marketing coverage. The jury may make investment offers outside the prize grant.

## Final round

The final round takes place on 8 October 2026 as part of the TOKEN2049 Singapore program at Marina Bay Sands.

## Applications

NEXUS 2026 applications closed after the 18 September deadline, with the top 50 announcement on 21 September. The organizer is accepting waitlist registrations for NEXUS 2027.

description:

## Schedule

Registrations opened on 19 August with an application deadline of 18 September and participants announced on 28 September, ahead of the 6-8 October hackathon.

To keep the competition fair, all project work must begin after the official hacking period starts. Participants may brainstorm ideas in advance, but no code, designs or prototypes before kickoff. The venue provides rest and chill-out spaces on a first-come, first-served basis.

name: The Institutional Table: Private Dinner on Tokenization, Stablecoins and Security | Token2049 Singapore
description:
21 seats. One table. No panel, no pitch deck.

The Institutional Table is a private, invite-only dinner hosted by QuillAudits on the closing night of Token2049 Singapore. Banks, asset managers, funds, exchanges, custodians, tokenization platforms and stablecoin issuers, in one room, talking about what it actually takes to put regulated assets on public chains without getting burned.

What we will talk about

Tokenization at scale: what breaks when a fund, bond or money market structure moves on-chain. ERC-3643, ERC-4626 vaults, NAV oracles, transfer restrictions and the compliance layer around them. Lessons from Project Guardian pilots going to production.

Stablecoins as payment rails: MAS-regulated issuance, reserve attestations, mint and burn controls, blacklist and freeze functions, and where issuers have been exploited.

The institutional security bar: what a board, a regulator and a counterparty should be able to ask for before capital moves. Audits, formal verification, monitoring, key management, incident response.

What went wrong in 2026: a closed-door walk through the year's institutional-grade incidents, and what each one should have caught earlier.

Format

Seated dinner for 21. Short opening from QuillAudits, then moderated conversation under Chatham House rules. No recording, no press, no slides.

Who is at the table

Heads of digital assets, treasury and product at banks and asset managers. Founders and CxOs of tokenization platforms and stablecoin issuers. Fund partners with RWA and stablecoin exposure. Regulators and policy leads by invitation.

Seats are confirmed personally. Registering here is a request, not a confirmation. Venue in the Marina Bay area, shared with confirmed guests.

About QuillAudits

8+ years securing Web3. 1,500+ audits, 1M+ lines reviewed. 20+ RWA and tokenization protocols audited including Plume, Lumia, Pharos and Zoth. Full lifecycle security: AI and human audits, formal verification, OpSec, multisig review and monitoring.

name: F1 Sprint Race and Grand Prix Qualifying
description:
Saturday's Formula 1 program at the 2026 Singapore Grand Prix includes the Sprint and Grand Prix qualifying at the Marina Bay Street Circuit.

## Saturday, 10 October

The track program runs on local Singapore time: the Porsche Carrera Cup Asia qualifying session at 15:00-15:30, the Formula 1 Sprint of 21 laps or 60 minutes at 17:00-17:30, the Formula 1 press conference at 17:30-18:00, the Porsche Carrera Cup Asia first race at 19:45-20:20, the Grand Prix qualifying session at 21:00-22:00, and a further press conference at 22:00-23:00.

## Circuit

The night race takes place at the 4.927-kilometre Marina Bay Street Circuit. The official timetable is subject to change.

## Circuit

The Marina Bay Circuit arrived on the scene in 2008 with the city skyline as its backdrop, hosting the first night-time race in Formula 1 history. After a 2023 layout change the lap runs 19 corners over 4.927 kilometres, and the bumpy street surface plus humidity make it one of the most physically demanding races on the calendar.

## Following the weekend

The sessions can be followed live on F1 TV, with tickets and hospitality packages available through Formula 1 official channels.
